statement: Pinned Linux hid-nintendo calibrates and reports all three six-axis IMU samples from a left-type Joy-Con on a separate motion input node without additional axis-order or sign inversion; the Y/Z sign inversion branch applies only to right-capable Joy-Con types. Accelerometer values use ABS_X/Y/Z and gyro uses ABS_RX/RY/RZ.

applicability.revision: Linux 4056b3c9d3c92ea45955641dbafeb9b960e146ef; SDL3 535d80badefc83c5c527ec5748f2a20d6a9310fe; source-only; no host or hardware
applicability.scope: Linux input IMU coordinate transform, not physical board axes, absolute sensor response or runtime output.
